generation_parents.algorithm: Adjust the incumbent's savings coefficient modestly from 0.5 to 0.55 and the capacity bonus from 0.15 to 0.20 while keeping the far-anchor start unchanged, to test whether slightly stronger route-continuation weighting improves total distance.

Adjust the incumbent's savings coefficient modestly from 0.5 to 0.55 and the capacity bonus from 0.15 to 0.20 while keeping the far-anchor start unchanged, to test whether slightly stronger route-continuation weighting improves total distance.

declared_hypothesis: A coefficient adjustment could improve route continuation more than further expanding the weak fill adjustment.
